gate_contract.normalization: NFD + lowercase + combining-mark removal + non-word replacement + whitespace collapse (exact pilot implementation)
gate_contract.exact: reject complete normalized equality with a MATH-500 test item
gate_contract.13gram: reject any shared normalized word 13-gram with MATH-500
gate_contract.8gram: reject when more than 50% of the candidate MATH-train problem's distinct normalized word 8-grams occur in one MATH-500 item
gate_contract.denominator: candidate MATH-train problem distinct 8-grams; not test-item 8-grams
